mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM blog_article_like al INNER JOIN blog_article a ON a.id = al.article_id INNER JOIN blog_category c ON c.id = a.category_id INNER JOIN blog_category pc ON pc.id = c.parent_id WHERE al.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.level = 2 AND c.status = 'ENABLED' AND pc.level = 1 AND pc.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY al.created_at DESC, al.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_article_like (article_id, user_id, visitor_token_hash) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{userId}, #{visitorTokenHash}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
